scope: Offline feature selection and GP uncertainty/region-type study on archived Comp3 data. Active future simulator is 26R1; do not rewrite archived provenance.
spatial_types: Both bands require >=50 GT lane pixels. Spatial type 1: near recall<.8 and far recall<.5; type 2: near>=.8 and far<.5; type 3: near<.8 and far>=.5; type 0 both good. Whole-frame IoU<.7 remains a separate overlapping event.
selection: Conditional grouped hyperparameter CV given previously selected24 fields; compact feature selection also uses development. Not fully nested feature-selection CV. External archive opened after the first feature/model freeze; later coverage fits use it only diagnostically.
uncertainty_policies: joint global-low and far-only type probabilities
amendment: v3 before external scores, after grouped feature screen
gp_kernel_variants: group-balanced Matern 3/2, equal average squared-distance per appearance/prediction/confidence/structure group
additional_policy: risk-weighted anticipated conditional-variance reduction in a 64-frame candidate window, never using unselected GT
quality_training_variants: base +192 uniformly sampled known diagnostic frames
base +192 GP posterior conditional-variance-selected known diagnostic frames
augmentation_scope: Promote these previously opened diagnostic data to quality-model training; do not report them as held-out afterward. Perception checkpoint remains frozen. Input-only selection IDs and hashes precede accessing augmentation labels in the training stage.
publication_scope: Post-run description correcting the original plan wording; original plan remains unchanged on the experiment volume.
